items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We’re on a video together. There was a Steve Allen show featuring Lionel Hampton, Don Lamond, myself, and, I think, Mel Lewis.

ctx.x: Don Lamond, another great player. I used to see Don Lamond – he comes from Washington, D.C., by the way. Did you know that, Ken?
